item.title: Added: Nov. 10, 2026: Lines 10 & 25 Long-Term Stop Closures
item.description:

Nov. 10, 2026: Lines 10 & 25 Long-Term Stop Closures
Impacted Stops: 5428, 6297, 6298 & 6383
Impacted Lines: 10 & 25

Due to construction, Stop 5428 located at E. Broad St. & Taylor Station Rd., Stop 6383 located at E. Broad St. & McNaughten Rd. and Stop 6297 located at E. Broad St. & Outerbelt St. are closed and expected to reopen in summer 2027. Stop 6298 located at E. Broad St. & Outerbelt St. is expected to reopen first, by early 2027. During this time, Line 10 and Line 25 riders should use nearby same-directional stops during this time.

item.title: Added: Sept. 25, 2026–Early 2028: MLK Jr. Blvd. / Mt. Vernon Ave. Construction Impacts
item.description:
First observed on the COTA reroutes page.

Sept. 25, 2026–Early 2028: MLK Jr. Blvd. / Mt. Vernon Ave. Construction Impacts
Impacted Area: Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd. / Mt. Vernon Ave. between Hamilton Ave. and N. Champion Ave.

Beginning Friday, Sept. 25, construction on Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd. / Mt. Vernon Ave. between Hamilton Ave. and N. Champion Ave. will shift to one lane in each direction.

As part of this project, Line 7 will be detoured to E. Long St. between Hamilton Ave. and N. Champion Ave. Stops along Mt. Vernon Ave. will be temporarily closed. Customers are encouraged to plan ahead and allow additional travel time while the detour is in effect.

item.title: Added: March 2, 2026: Stop 3825 Relocation at W. North Broadway
item.description:
First observed on the COTA reroutes page.

March 2, 2026: Stop 3825 Relocation at W. North Broadway
Impacted Stop: 3825
Impacted Lines: 1, 32 and 72

Beginning Monday, March 2, Stop 3825 near the Riverside Hospital staircase will be relocated approximately 200 feet east to W. North Broadway due to roadway construction.

The stop will remain in service at its new location and will be served by Lines 1, 32 and 72. This relocation is expected to remain in place through 2027.
